field.label: List group
field.help: The list group this allow list belongs to. The list takes effect only for clients assigned this group under Clients. Within a group, allow list entries override deny lists; a group with only allow lists permits only those domains and blocks everything else.

field.label: Source
field.help: An http or https URL to a hosts/domain list, an absolute file path (a file:// prefix is accepted), or a single inline entry. Anything that is not a URL or an absolute path is written into Blocky's configuration as an inline entry, so a relative path is read as a domain, not as a file. An entry is a domain (good.example.com), which also covers its subdomains, a wildcard (*.good.example.com), or a regular expression between slashes (/^good[0-9]*\./). Blocky warns when a group holds many regular expressions, as they are slow to search.
